tcad_track.mesh: DEVSIM structured mesh; Gmsh optional for later irregular geometry
tcad_track.baseline_scope: complete T01 single-gate drift-diffusion numerical gate plus complete T02 dual-gate numerical gate, the complete T03-P4-L channel-length group, the complete numerical T03-P1 bias-and-coupling group, and the complete T03-P2 bottom-interface DIT substage
tcad_track.next_scope: establish the formal isolated NTA/NGA transfer-sensitivity contract; formal sensitivity runs, P3, P5, SPICE, circuits, layout, and HZO remain closed
tcad_track.evidence_boundary: T02-C closes only the frozen teaching-model numerical gate. T03-P4-L adds one complete E3 three-point channel-length group while retaining the failed ideal 1/L diagnostic. Numerical P1 is complete through E3 P1-BIAS and P1-CAP-RATIO substages; the latter varies a fixed-total-coupling allocation proxy and is not measured capacitance, measured Al2O3 permittivity, or a fabricated asymmetric stack. The T03-P2 bottom-interface DIT substage has E3 contract, equation-smoke, formal three-point transfer-sensitivity, persisted-state, and independent-check evidence. The separate bulk-trap input contract is E3 static evidence, and its zero-control, NTA-reference, and NGA-reference equation smoke completed 3 devices and 21 coupled DC solves with E2 runner evidence and E3 independent persisted-evidence verification. Formal isolated NTA/NGA transfer sensitivity, complete P2, P3, P5, complete T03, experimental calibration, physical DOS or parameter validation, uncertainty, compact models, circuits, layout, and HZO remain unverified.

teaching_baseline.allowed_use: T01 teaching-parameter initialization and sanity checks
teaching_baseline.prohibited_use: experimental fitting or calibrated dual-gate prediction

baseline_process.top_gate_status: research extension; not present in the stated fabricated baseline

logic_style.principle: Use a second gate to tune the load-device effective threshold while the driver network implements n-type ratioed logic.
limitations: ratioed logic has static current in the low-output state
noise margin and output swing require load/driver sizing
active-load claims require a calibrated dual-gate threshold shift

evidence_boundary: Teaching and research PDK only; not foundry sign-off. The ngspice model is a behavioral equivalent, not native HSPICE Level61. Active-load logic remains planned until dual-gate threshold control is calibrated.
